name: Tabular Iris feature pipeline
description: Every feature ends with a mean near 0

data.noteContent:
Iris is 150 rows, four measurements and three species: the smallest table that still needs every step of a real tabular pipeline. Those steps are the graph, left to right: read the CSV, take all four columns, split into train and test, then z-score. The upper Normalize fits each column's mean and std on the 120 training rows only; its stats output carries them to the lower Normalize, which applies the same numbers to the 30 test rows. Fitting on the whole table first would let the test rows shape the training data. After a run the Print shows one mean per feature of the scaled test rows. The training columns sit at zero exactly; the test columns land near it, the largest about 0.10 away, because they were scaled with statistics they did not help compute. A mean far from zero would say the test split does not look like the training split: raise test_size, or turn stratify off, and watch them move.

Iris 有 150 列、四個量測欄位、三個品種，是還用得上完整表格流程的最小資料集。那些步驟就是這張圖由左到右的順序：讀進 CSV、四個欄位全取、切成訓練集與測試集，再做 z-score。上面的 Normalize 只用 120 列訓練資料算出每欄的平均與標準差，透過 stats 輸出交給下面的 Normalize，把同一組數字套用到 30 列測試資料。先對整張表做 z-score 的話，測試資料就會影響訓練資料。跑完之後，Print 會印出縮放後測試資料每個特徵的平均值。訓練集每一欄剛好是 0；測試集各欄落在 0 附近，最遠的大約差 0.10，因為它們用的統計量不是由自己算出來的。某一欄離 0 很遠，就表示測試集和訓練集長得不像：把 test_size 調大，或把 stratify 關掉，看它們怎麼動。

stratify keeps all three species at the proportion they have in the table: exactly 10 of each in the 30-row test set. Turn it off and the counts drift with the seed -- which on an imbalanced dataset is how a rare class ends up with no test rows at all.

stratify 讓三個品種維持它們在原表裡的比例：30 列的測試集剛好每種 10 列。關掉之後，數量會隨著 seed 浮動 — 換成類別不平衡的資料集，稀有類別就可能一列測試資料都分不到。
